items.title: Canva's first AI image model plans designs before generating them
items.excerpt: Canva released Craft, its first in-house image generation model, built for design layouts rather than photography: it plans a composition before generating it, putting Canva in direct competition with OpenAI, Google and Microsoft image models.

items.title: Wildwood's director says AI is 'antithetical to everything that we are at this studio'
items.excerpt: LAIKA's Travis Knight explains why the stop-motion studio refuses generative AI in its craft pipeline for Wildwood: 'There's no humanity behind it.'

items.title: How Lufthansa Systems prototypes realistic maps for the cockpit with Figma Make
items.excerpt: Lufthansa Systems' designers use Figma Make's AI prompt-to-prototype flow to build dynamic, data-realistic cockpit map prototypes for pilot user testing instead of static mockups.

items.title: AI Agent Actions: same rules for UI and agents
items.excerpt: Builder.io argues apps should expose agent actions that enforce the same rules as the UI: if the interface blocks an edit, an AI agent shouldn't be able to make it either.

items.title: I gave my coding agent a color palette library, and stopped pasting hex codes
items.excerpt: A developer wires a structured color palette library into Claude as a tool so the coding agent pulls accessible, named design colors instead of inventing six random hex codes.

items.title: How Siemens Designcenter is infusing cutting-edge technology into product development
items.excerpt: Siemens details how Designcenter (NX) combines AI assistants, cloud and immersive capabilities to connect modern engineering and product-design workflows.

items.title: AI's next bottleneck is the engineer's desk
items.excerpt: Nomic is helping Arcadis automate engineering design reviews with AI, but the article argues the next bottleneck is human checking of AI-generated design output.

items.title: NVIDIA Cosmos opens new tools to train, evaluate and deploy world models
items.excerpt: New tools in NVIDIA Cosmos speed data pipelines and help teams train, evaluate and optimize world models at lower cost, feeding synthetic-scene generation for physical AI.

items.title: A founder with a tool is not a founder with a clue
items.excerpt: AI lets a solo founder ship a product alone, but can't tell them whether it's any good; the piece argues design judgment, not AI-generated output, still decides who wins.

items.title: AI doesn't care about your job title
items.excerpt: AI exposure runs through the tasks a designer does each week, not the title on their badge; the author shows how to measure your own exposure and lower the risk.

items.title: Buy vs. build is now also a UX decision, especially in enterprise
items.excerpt: AI made building cheap and buying easy, so the buy-vs-build trade-off now turns on upkeep, tool seams, chat surfaces and data, and designers belong at that table.

items.title: This 'Malfoid' AI Harry Potter romance is weird, uncomfortable and surprisingly revealing
items.excerpt: A viral AI-generated fan series gender-swapping Draco Malfoy raises awkward questions about AI video, IP and what audiences now accept as creative work.

items.title: Google Meet's appearance filters just sent me into an existential spiral
items.excerpt: A designer's critique of Google Meet's AI 'touch up your appearance' prompt and what AI beauty filters baked into work tools mean for professional image norms.

items.title: Lock In Character Likeness for AI Posters in Firefly
items.excerpt: Adobe tutorial: use a reference-sheet trick in Firefly so an AI-generated subject stays recognizable across every pose, angle and scene of a poster series.

items.title: Optimize AI credits with the Figma agent
items.excerpt: Figma walks through prompting best practices for its agent to get better results while spending fewer AI credits.

items.title: ShipSF Workshops - Embed Generative UI Agents in Your App with Codex and Vercel
items.excerpt: Vercel Ship SF workshop on embedding generative UI agents into an app with Codex and the Vercel AI stack, so the agent renders interface components rather than text.
